function.name: impl_from_IPropertyBag2
function.description: This function returns the containing record for the given interface, effectively casting the interface to its containing type.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: The interface from which to retrieve the containing record.

function.return_type: PropertyBag *. It represents the containing record for the given interface.

function.name: PropertyBag_QueryInterface
function.description: This function checks if the provided interface ID matches either IID_IUnknown or IID_IPropertyBag2. If it does, it assigns the address of the IPropertyBag2 interface to the provided void pointer. If it doesn't, it assigns NULL to the provided void pointer and returns an error code.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IPropertyBag2 interface

parameters.name: iid
parameters.description: Interface ID to be checked

parameters.name: ppv
parameters.description: Pointer to a void pointer where the address of the IPropertyBag2 interface will be stored if the provided interface ID matches either IID_IUnknown or IID_IPropertyBag2

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, E_INVALIDARG if the ppv parameter is NULL, and E_NOINTERFACE if the provided interface ID doesn't match either IID_IUnknown or IID_IPropertyBag2

function.name: PropertyBag_AddRef
function.description: This function increments the reference count of the PropertyBag object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the IPropertyBag2 interface.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count after increment.

function.name: PropertyBag_Release
function.description: This function releases the memory allocated for the properties and values of the PropertyBag object, and then frees the object itself when its reference count reaches zero.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IPropertyBag2 interface of the PropertyBag object.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the updated reference count of the PropertyBag object after decrementing.

function.name: find_item
function.description: This function searches for a property by name in a PropertyBag object and returns its index if found, otherwise returns -1.

parameters.name: This
parameters.description: The PropertyBag object in which to search for the property.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the property to search for.

function.return_type: LONG, represents the index of the found property in the PropertyBag object, or -1 if the property is not found or the input parameters are invalid.

function.name: PropertyBag_Read
function.description: This function reads properties from a property bag. It iterates over the properties and copies the values if found. If a property is not found, it fails and breaks the loop.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface of the property bag

parameters.name: cProperties
parameters.description: Count of properties to be read

parameters.name: pPropBag
parameters.description: Pointer to the property bag structure

parameters.name: pErrLog
parameters.description: Pointer to the error log

parameters.name: pvarValue
parameters.description: Pointer to the variant value to be filled with the property value

parameters.name: phrError
parameters.description: Pointer to the HRESULT error code

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. S_OK if successful, E_FAIL if it fails to find a property

function.name: PropertyBag_Write
function.description: This function writes properties to a property bag. It iterates over the properties and checks if the property type matches the expected type. If it does, it copies the value to the property bag. If it doesn't, it returns an error. If the property is unknown, it logs a warning and returns an error.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IPropertyBag2 interface

parameters.name: cProperties
parameters.description: Count of properties to be written

parameters.name: pPropBag
parameters.description: Pointer to the property bag where the properties are to be written

parameters.name: pvarValue
parameters.description: Pointer to the variant values to be written to the property bag

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the function execution. S_OK if successful, E_FAIL if an error occurred, WINCODEC_ERR_PROPERTYUNEXPECTEDTYPE if the property type does not match the expected type.

function.name: PropertyBag_CountProperties
function.description: This function counts the properties in a PropertyBag object and returns the count in the pcProperties parameter.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the PropertyBag object.

parameters.name: pcProperties
parameters.description: Pointer to a ULONG variable where the count of properties will be stored.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if the operation is successful, and E_INVALIDARG if the pcProperties parameter is NULL.

function.name: copy_propbag2
function.description: This function copies the contents of a source PROPBAG2 structure to a destination PROPBAG2 structure. It also allocates memory for the pstrName string in the destination structure.

parameters.name: dest
parameters.description: Pointer to the destination PROPBAG2 structure

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: Pointer to the source PROPBAG2 structure

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if the operation is successful, E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation fails

function.name: PropertyBag_GetPropertyInfo
function.description: This function retrieves information about one or more properties in a property bag.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IPropertyBag2 interface.

parameters.name: iProperty
parameters.description: The zero-based index of the first property for which to retrieve information.

parameters.name: cProperties
parameters.description: The count of properties for which to retrieve information.

parameters.name: pPropBag
parameters.description: Pointer to an array of PROPBAG2 structures that receive the property information.

parameters.name: pcProperties
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable that receives the count of properties for which information is retrieved.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if successful, or an error value otherwise.

function.name: PropertyBag_LoadObject
function.description: This function is currently a stub and not implemented. It is expected to load an object into a property bag.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IPropertyBag2 interface

parameters.name: pstrName
parameters.description: Pointer to a string that specifies the name of the property

parameters.name: dwHint
parameters.description: A hint to the property bag about how the property should be loaded

parameters.name: pUnkObject
parameters.description: Pointer to the IUnknown interface on the object to be loaded

parameters.name: pErrLog
parameters.description: Pointer to an IErrorLog interface that the property bag can use to log errors

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. In this case, it always returns E_NOTIMPL indicating that the function is not implemented.

function.name: CreatePropertyBag2
function.description: This function creates a new PropertyBag2 object and initializes it with the given options and count. It also handles memory allocation and error checking for the new object.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Pointer to an array of PROPBAG2 structures that specify the properties to be contained in the new property bag.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: The number of properties to be contained in the new property bag.

parameters.name: ppPropertyBag2
parameters.description: Address of a pointer to the new IPropertyBag2 interface.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the function execution. S_OK if the function succeeds, E_OUTOFMEMORY if there is insufficient memory to create the property bag.
